response.sql:
SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS conservation_record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS status_share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: A missing insurance status forms its own group; the foreign key ensures each conservation record has a matching site.
